kind: diagnostic CPU profiles, not latency measurements

method.launch: owned supervisor and workload descendants; natural termination

failed.failure: py-spy reported ECHILD after saving its recording

not_started.reason: serial execution stopped at the prior unsuccessful command

limitations: Inclusive function counts overlap and are not additive function times.
One recording per case/build cannot establish a speed difference or a regression cause.
All recorded orjson native frames lack C/Rust source attribution in this wheel.
CPython executable labels include unresolved addresses and implausible symbols; do not use them as function-cost evidence.
Sampling-error counts are preserved; the default logger did not emit their underlying error messages.
Profiles do not replace correctness, memory-safety, or compatibility testing.
